candidates.change_summary: Change the require to check msg.sender equals the public variable depositorAccount (lowercase) to instead check against the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT (uppercase), so a different address is enforced before setting state.
Remove the require guard entirely so anyone can call setL1BlockValues, changing who can set the state.
Invert the require condition to require msg.sender is NOT the depositorAccount, allowing everyone except the depositor to call it.
After the require, assign the input parameters into the contract state, so calling setL1BlockValues updates state variables.
Change the require to compare to the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT but also keep the original error message; this enforces a different address for callers.
